sloka: विद्युन्माली रथस्थस्तु शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः ।सुषेणं ताडयामास ननाद च मुहुर्मुहुः ।। ६.४३.३५ ।।।।
transliteration: vidyunmālī rathasthastu śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।suṣeṇaṁ tāḍayāmāsa nanāda ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। 6.43.35 ।।।।

translations.english: Nay, Sushena, the leader of Vanaras, saw himself down and Jambumali on top in the chariot. He crushed him with a big mountain peak.
